leadText:
----
 
(Japanese: Pokémon Mezastar: Aim to Be a Tag Master!) is a Pokémon manga by Kemon Kawamoto. It was serialized in the CoroCoro Ichiban! magazine from the January 2021 issue (released on November 21, 2020) to the February 2024 issue (released on December 21, 2023). It is based on the arcade game Pokémon Mezastar. It tells the story of Kira Hoshio.

(Japanese: Pokémon Mezastar: Aim to Be a Tag Master!) is a Pokémon manga by Kemon Kawamoto. It was serialized in the CoroCoro Ichiban! magazine from the January 2021 issue (released on November 21, 2020) to the February 2024 issue (released on December 21, 2023). It is based on the arcade game Pokémon Mezastar. It tells the story of Kira Hoshio.

==Characters==
Kira Hoshio (Japanese: Hoshio Kira). He is the main character. He debuted in MTM01.
Suguru Tsukino (Japanese: Tsukino Suguru). He is Kira's classmate. He debuted in MTM01.
Douji Futakata (Japanese: Futakata Douji). He debuted in MTM05.
Rekuto Kuroko (Japanese: Kuroko Rekuto). He collects strong tags. He debuted in MTM07.
Mirai (Japanese: Mirai). He is a streamer. He debuted in MTM13.
Kanon Tenou (Japanese: Tenou Kanon). She debuted in MTM15.
